verdict.rationale: The pack never documents institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, or an error-code taxonomy that separates institution-side failures from integration errors. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Item-change webhooks (plaid-docs-8), Dashboard MCP Item debugging (plaid-docs-9), and generic SDK try/catch error handling (plaid-gh-1, plaid-gh-2). None of these is per-institution health visibility.
